entries.en: Who could it be at this hour...?

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: I showed mom the calling card. I was[n]a little scared, too.

entries.speaker: Shinya
entries.en: Let the Phantom Thieves know for me.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: It couldn't have been done without you.[n]Thank you.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: That being said, the real battle starts[n]here. We'll need to put forth our best[n]effort from now on.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'm calling you so you're aware of[n]the rumors circulating about the[n]snap election.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I think there is only a month or so left[n]that I can have you help me.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: By law, I can't hire underage help during[n]the election.

entries.speaker: Yoshida
entries.en: I'm sorry, but please keep that in mind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Thank you for humoring me today.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I may have won today, but I don't enjoy[n]having left without giving you the chance[n]to recoup your loss.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: As I mentioned before, I'd accept a[n]rematch if you were to challenge me[n]to one.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Let's see, I'll be... at the plaza in front of[n]Shibuya Station.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: If you wish to go again, feel free to[n]come by. All right, I'll be waiting...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks like Akechi will be in Shibuya[n]for a while. But wait—a rematch?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...So that's what you two were doing in[n]Mementos? Look, there's a lot going on[n]right now. Just be careful, okay?
